scope_reason: User-authorized fruit-first completion. Freeze SFT90 and its single PPO descendant before inspecting reserved outcomes.
interface: published VLABench pi05 primitive pose control

ordinary.initialization_rule: Use the first ten numerical seeds of the existing reserved manifests, chosen before reading their outcomes; no exclusions based on policy performance.

fruit_language.initialization_rule: Use the first three numerical seeds of the existing reserved paired language manifests, before inspecting outcomes.

comparison_rule: Same complete initial state, input RGB, literal prompt, JAX seeded evaluation noise, control interface and execution budget for all three stages. Training exploration uses RLinf flow-SDE separately.
reporting: Report successes/trials, Wilson 95% intervals, paired outcome changes and recorded failure evidence. Development, ordinary and language suites stay separate. These small pilot samples do not prove a statistically significant improvement.
unexecuted_reserve: Seeds 1511-1520 and 1604-1610 are outside this bounded pilot and remain pending; do not imply that the original full evaluation suite is complete.
